classification.resume: This is a digital parliamentary record of a debate in the Swiss National Council on March 7, 2017, concerning a motion by Olivier Feller to relax the conditions for short-time work compensation in the service sector. The debate featured speeches by Olivier Feller and Johann N. Schneider-Ammann. It documents legislative discussion rather than enacting legislation.
